findings.heading: Load packages
findings.proposition: The English points the reader to the R basics page with a working cross-reference, [R basics](basics.qmd); the Russian keeps only the bare label [Основы R] with no link target.
findings.reader_consequence: The Russian reader sees the literal text [Основы R] rendered with no hyperlink, so cannot reach the page on R packages that the sentence tells them to consult.

findings.heading: Heat tiles
findings.proposition: The English points the reader to the Heat plots page with a working cross-reference, [Heat plots](heatmaps.qmd), for the code that builds the plot shown; the Russian keeps only the bare label [Тепловые графики] with no link target.
findings.reader_consequence: The Russian reader is told the explanation of this plot lives on another page but is given no link to it, and the chapter explicitly declines to explain the code here, so the explanation becomes unreachable.

findings.heading: Plot with ggplotly()
findings.proposition: The English states the summarised percentage is of cases with a KNOWN OUTCOME that died, naming the denominator; the Russian says only 'проценту известных случаев смерти' (percent of known death cases) and drops the known-outcome restriction on the denominator.
findings.reader_consequence: The Russian reader takes pct_death to be deaths over all cases, whereas the chunk immediately below computes pct_death = 100*(n_death / n_known_outcome), so they misread every value in the weekly_deaths table and in the line plot built from it.
